Position: Data Scientist
Location: Remote - United States
Our analytics division is expanding. We need someone comfortable working with Python, SQL, and statistical modeling. Candidates must have no fewer than 4 years of relevant experience. Familiarity with AWS is a bonus. The annual compensation package ranges between $125K and $160K.

Junior Data Analyst | Seattle, WA
We're expanding our reporting team. You should know Excel and SQL. Tableau would be nice to have, but isn't mandatory. This role requires working from our Seattle office. Starting pay is $72,000 annually. No previous professional experience is required.

Machine Learning Engineer
We're searching for someone who can develop and deploy production ML systems. Python, TensorFlow, and Kubernetes are mandatory. A background in AWS is preferred. You should bring at least five years of industry experience. The team meets in our office twice a week. Salary: $145,000-$185,000 per year.

We're looking for a Data Engineer to support our growing data infrastructure. Experience with Apache Spark, Python, and SQL is essential. Knowledge of Airflow is a plus. The position allows employees to work from anywhere. Compensation will depend on qualifications.

AI Engineer — San Jose, California
We're building applications powered by large language models. The successful candidate must understand Python, LLMs, and vector databases. At least 2 years of software development experience required. Onsite work is mandatory. We offer between $110k and $150k annually.

Business Intelligence Analyst
Help transform business data into actionable insights. Strong SQL and Power BI skills are required. Knowledge of Python is desirable but optional. Candidates need 3+ years of analytical experience. Annual salary falls between $85K and $110K. Work location arrangements have not been finalized.

NLP Engineer Opportunity
Our research team develops language understanding systems. Applicants must demonstrate proficiency in Python, Hugging Face Transformers, and NLP. We welcome candidates from academic and industry backgrounds. This opportunity is fully remote. The expected annual compensation is $120,000 to $155,000.

Cloud Data Engineer — Austin, Texas
Join our cloud infrastructure team. AWS, Python, and Apache Airflow experience are required. The ideal candidate has at least 4 years of experience. Employees must report to our Austin office Monday through Friday. Salary details are available upon request.

Research Scientist, Applied Machine Learning
We're recruiting a researcher to investigate new ML methods. Required expertise includes Python, PyTorch, and statistics. Experience publishing research papers is preferred. Applicants should have 2 or more years of relevant experience. The position is remote within the United States. Base salary is between $135K and $180K annually.

Analytics Engineer
We're hiring someone to maintain our analytics pipelines. SQL and dbt are essential. Python familiarity is helpful but not required. This is a hybrid role based in Chicago. Compensation: $100,000-$130,000 annually. Prior professional experience is welcome but not mandatory.
